item.goal: In backend/app/domains/audit/service.py check_detail, the *_tokens exemption from the secret-named-key rule applies only to numeric values (int/float, or empty None/0): a secret-named key ending in _tokens whose value is a string, list, tuple or dict (e.g. refresh_tokens: "abc123" or ["abc123"]) is rejected with audit.detail_secret. Other exempt suffixes (_id, _ids, _fingerprint, _last4, _at, _count, has_/is_ prefixes) behave exactly as today.
